data_completeness.definition: Coverage across all business channels required for decisions (commerce, website, ads, email, social, leads, finance, operations).
strengths: Woo selected-range telemetry exists and is completeness/coverage gated.
deficiencies: Many panels are snapshot or connected_incomplete; email + profit/margin sources not integrated.
required_for_10: All key channels connected with validated coverage/freshness per range + per metric.

data_accuracy.definition: Correctness of key business totals/metrics relative to source-of-truth systems.
strengths: Woo paid-date net revenue definition is explicitly implemented + parity tested.
Timezone bug fixed (UTC vs local parsing).
deficiencies: Non-Woo sources accuracy not yet proven with parity checks.
required_for_10: Parity/contract tests for each connected channel; automated drift detection.

data_freshness.definition: How current the data is, with visible as-of timestamps and stale detection.
strengths: Woo telemetry includes as-of and coverage; confidence system flags stale.
deficiencies: Other sources freshness varies; not uniformly enforced across panels.
required_for_10: Unified freshness SLAs; consistent stale detection and suppression rules.

data_provenance.definition: Ability to trace each metric to its source, definition, completeness, and limitations.
strengths: Commerce telemetry summary returns definitionVersion/source/completeness/asOf/coverage.
deficiencies: Not all metrics show provenance; mixed-source derivations exist.
required_for_10: Every KPI + recommendation includes provenance + evidence links.

cross_channel_integration.definition: Joining signals from commerce, website, ads, email, social, press, leads into one coherent model.
strengths: Multiple sources are present in the UI and scheduler.
deficiencies: No canonical event timeline; limited join keys and attribution logic.
required_for_10: Canonical business-event model + joins (campaign/product/utm/customer) + cross-channel timelines.

historical_depth.definition: How far back the system has consistent historical data per channel.
strengths: Woo telemetry coverage is explicit once ingested.
deficiencies: Historical depth for GA4/meta/leads/social unclear until table mapping is audited.
required_for_10: Declared history windows per source; backfills where valuable.

attribution_quality.definition: Ability to attribute outcomes to channels/actions with explicit windows and confound handling.
strengths: Some comparison scaffolding exists in UI logic.
deficiencies: No explicit attribution model across Meta/Email/Social to Woo outcomes.
required_for_10: Attribution engine with evidence-grade claims + configurable windows; assisted conversion model.

explanation_quality.definition: Quality of answers to 'why did it happen?' with quantified drivers + evidence.
strengths: Change insights/top drivers panels exist.
deficiencies: Explanations appear mostly heuristic/correlational; no explicit hypothesis/evidence taxonomy.
required_for_10: Explanation engine that outputs: change → candidate causes → evidence → confidence → alternatives.

causal_reasoning.definition: Ability to distinguish causation from correlation and show confounds/alternatives.
strengths: Some partial/unknown gating exists.
deficiencies: No causal graph / model; no counterfactual framing.
required_for_10: Causal explanation architecture with explicit confidence + confound handling.

forecasting.definition: Ability to predict likely next outcomes with calibrated uncertainty.
deficiencies: No forecast model surfaces or backtesting.
required_for_10: Forecasting with baselines + confidence bands + eval.

recommendation_quality.definition: Recommendations are evidence-based, high-impact, and aligned with constraints.
strengths: Some action queue and opportunity scaffolding exists.
deficiencies: No unified recommendation engine with expected impact + confidence.
required_for_10: Recommendation engine with ranking, expected value, effort, risk, prerequisites.

recommendation_specificity.definition: Recommendations are specific, not generic; tied to entities/campaigns/products.
deficiencies: Prepared actions are not yet systematically generated.
required_for_10: Per-action templates and entity linking.

opportunity_detection.definition: Ability to detect and rank revenue opportunities with evidence.
strengths: Opportunity routes/panels exist.
deficiencies: No continuous ranked opportunity engine across channels.
required_for_10: Opportunity center with scoring + evidence + status tracking.

action_preparation.definition: System prepares execution-ready drafts (ads/emails/posts/outreach) for approval.
strengths: Some automation and agent scaffolding exists.
deficiencies: No standardized prepared-action artifacts per channel.
required_for_10: Action preparation layer with editable drafts + previews + diffs.

approval_controls.definition: Approval gating exists for consequential actions, with audit trail.
strengths: Task approval endpoints exist; scheduler auth exists.
deficiencies: Need unified L0–L5 policy and explicit external side-effect map.
required_for_10: Formal approval/execution policy; enforced in code; complete audit trail.

execution_capability.definition: System can execute approved actions via integrations.
strengths: Scheduler + automation endpoints exist.
deficiencies: External execution (Meta/email/social) not proven as implemented.
required_for_10: Least-privilege connectors + idempotent execution + rollback.

outcome_measurement.definition: Measures whether executed actions worked against baseline.
deficiencies: No formal outcome model tied to approvals/executions.
required_for_10: Outcome tracking entities + evaluation windows + reporting.

learning_feedback_loop.definition: System improves recommendations based on outcomes and rejections.
deficiencies: No learning loop data model or reuse logic.
required_for_10: Recommendation outcome store + reuse prevention rules + evaluation.

executive_usefulness.definition: Helps Keegan decide what to do today with clarity, speed, and trust.
strengths: Many panels exist; commerce telemetry now trustworthy when complete.
deficiencies: Too much reporting; not enough explanation/recommendation/action readiness.
required_for_10: Summary → explanation → evidence → action loop.

ux_hierarchy.definition: Information hierarchy, progressive disclosure, and clarity.
strengths: DashboardShell organizes sections; range controls exist.
deficiencies: Hierarchy optimized for many panels vs executive loop; explanations buried.
required_for_10: Executive-first hierarchy: summary → why → what now.

strengths: Recent production browser validation passed (no overflow).
deficiencies: No explicit mobile-first KPI loop or performance budget.
required_for_10: Mobile-first UX plus measured performance + tests.

strengths: Server route exists; caching disabled for correctness.
deficiencies: No performance budgets/benchmarks; potential heavy compute in overview route.
required_for_10: Perf budgets + tracing + load tests; fast-path caches with provenance.

reliability.definition: Resilience to partial sources with correct fallbacks and clear state.
strengths: Confidence model distinguishes unknown vs complete; Woo now stable.
deficiencies: Need source-by-source SLAs + alerts + automated remediation.
required_for_10: Reliability contract per source; automated monitoring + backfill.

security.definition: Least-privilege secrets, server-only auth, separation of prod vs staging.
strengths: Dashboard API auth is server-only; secrets not in client; 1Password references used.
deficiencies: Need explicit connector scoping + audit logs for execution actions.
required_for_10: Full least-privilege connector model + rotation + audit.

auditability.definition: Audit trail for ingestions, derived metrics, recommendations, approvals, executions.
strengths: Woo ingestion runs table exists.
deficiencies: No end-to-end audit trail across recommendations and outcomes.
required_for_10: Canonical audit log events across all actions and model outputs.
